title: It's good but some obvious improvements needed
body:
Pros: 
• fairly intuitive. 
• more colours available than Apple stock calendar
• themed events stand out such as meals, doctors appointments, phone calls etc with respective art work (my adhd brain loves such distinction)
• I love the various viewing options including "schedule"
• integration of tasks and reminders as separate to events
• just the overall structure is the best in overall feel and interface compared to other apps, I find it the most suitable for my neurodivergent brain

Cons: 
• home screen app icon should really display current date not default 31
• wish there was an option to have all colours available within events, not just when choosing default event, same for tasks and reminders. Overall more customisation freedom basically would be great. Also more neutral colour options such as white, grey and/or black. Neurodivergents like me will know what I mean. 
• wish there was an option to hide completed tasks automatically rather than just crossing them out. My brain doesn't feel tasks are "done" if I can still see them and it bugs me
• wish there were more options to drag and drop say all day events into the day for a specific time rather than having to manually open the even and change it from within. In general drag and drop could be smoother also from day to day. 

Overall my fav calendar app I keep coming back to since others don't have the features I like even if they might have one that this app doesn't have, just really wish the above would he implemented and it would be the perfect cal app for me.

6. I use the Leeds bin app and I’m able to say add to calendar on that app and it automatically adds the dates to google calander 

7. When adding things to do you can customise it so you can say re-occur every week on a Monday or re-occur once a year for example birthdays/Anniversariesor even re-occur two times a week for three months

I actually prefer this over all the other Callander apps out there, Iv even recommended it to work colleagues and Service users when they have seen my Callander
